Get Maxar / Vantor WMS Basemap as GeoTIFF or Spatial Raster Object

Source: R/vantor_api_getmap.R
get_maxar_wms_basemap.Rd

Retrieves a Maxar/Vantor Vivid Mosaic basemap (30 cm or 15 cm) via OGC WMS for a specified area of interest. Supports spatial inputs from sf, terra, and stars, as well as numeric bounding boxes, and can return a file path, terra::SpatRaster, or stars object.

Usage

get_maxar_wms_basemap(
  bbox,
  token = NULL,
  output_file = tempfile(pattern = "vantor_basemap_", fileext = ".tif"),
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  resolution = 0.3,
  product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30",
  crs = c("EPSG:3857", "EPSG:4326"),
  cql_filter = NULL,
  shoreline_masking = FALSE,
  api_key = NULL,
  return_type = c("file", "SpatRaster", "stars", "stars_proxy"),
  verbose = getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE)
)

Arguments

bbox

A spatial object (sf, sfc, bbox, SpatRaster, SpatVector, SpatExtent, stars, stars_proxy) or a numeric vector of length 4: c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax). Automatically transformed to the target crs.

token

Character string. Optional OAuth2 bearer token from get_maxar_token(). If NULL, resolved via api_key, session cache (vantor_auth()), or environment variables.

output_file

Character string. Path where the GeoTIFF file will be saved. Defaults to tempfile(pattern = "vantor_basemap_", fileext = ".tif") in compliance with CRAN policies.

width

Integer. Width of the output image in pixels. If NULL, calculated from resolution.

height

Integer. Height of the output image in pixels. If NULL, calculated from resolution.

resolution

Numeric. Target ground resolution in meters. Default is 0.3 (30 cm). Used to calculate width and height if not explicitly provided.

product

Character string. Vivid product name. Default is "VIVID_STANDARD_30". Options include "VIVID_STANDARD_30" and "VIVID_ADVANCED_15".

crs

Character string. Output CRS requested from WMS ("EPSG:3857" or "EPSG:4326"). Default is "EPSG:3857".

cql_filter

Character string. Optional custom CQL filter. If NULL, constructed automatically from product and shoreline_masking.

shoreline_masking

Logical. Apply shoreline masking. Default is FALSE.

api_key

Character string. Optional Maxar/Vantor API key (maxar-api-key).

return_type

Character string. Return format: "file" (default, returns the file path invisibly), "SpatRaster" (returns a terra::SpatRaster), "stars" (returns an in-memory stars object), or "stars_proxy".

verbose

Logical. Print progress messages. Default is getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE).

Value

Depending on return_type, the path to the saved GeoTIFF file (invisibly when return_type = "file"), a SpatRaster, or a stars object. Returns NULL invisibly (with an informative message) if the API request fails.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (vantor_has_auth()) {
  # Define area of interest using an sf bounding box (WGS84)
  aoi <- sf::st_bbox(
    c(xmin = -105.005, ymin = 39.735, xmax = -105.000, ymax = 39.740),
    crs = sf::st_crs(4326)
  )

  # Retrieve basemap to a temporary GeoTIFF file
  tif_file <- get_maxar_wms_basemap(
    bbox = aoi,
    resolution = 0.5,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
}
# }
